operations.description: Represents the set of geocoded and standardized sites and intersections whose address best matches a given query address.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] addresses output format [PARAMS] address auto back bbox brief centre civic code complete descriptor designator direction distance echo extrapolate format interpolation localities locality location match max min name not number output parcel point precision province qualifier results score set site srs street string suffix type unit [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents intersections near a given point
operations.summary: Find intersections near to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] intersections near output format [PARAMS] degree distance format max min output point results srs [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the closest intersection to a given point
operations.summary: Find nearest intersection to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] intersections nearest output format [PARAMS] degree distance format max min output point srs [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents all intersections within a given area
operations.summary: Find intersections in a geographic area
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] intersections within output format [PARAMS] bbox degree format max min output results srs [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get an intersection by its unique ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] intersections [PARAMS] format id intersection output srs [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the set of occupants whose addresses best match a given query address. Every occupant has an associated site which has a standardized address and a coordinate location on the Earth.
operations.summary: Geocode an address and identify site occupants
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] occupants addresses output format [PARAMS] address auto back bbox brief centre civic code complete descriptor designator direction distance echo extrapolate format interpolation localities locality location match max min name not number output parcel point precision province qualifier results score set site srs street string suffix tags type unit [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents occupants near a given point in order of closest to farthest
operations.summary: Find occupants of sites near to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] occupants near output format [PARAMS] back brief descriptor distance format location max output point results set srs tags [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the closest occupant to a given point
operations.summary: Find occupants of the site nearest to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] occupants nearest output format [PARAMS] back brief descriptor distance format location max output point set srs tags [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents all occupants within a given area
operations.summary: Find occupants of sites in a geographic area
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] occupants within output format [PARAMS] back bbox brief descriptor format location max output results set srs tags [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get an occupant (of a site) by its unique ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] occupants [PARAMS] back brief descriptor format id location occupant output set srs [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents all parcel identifiers associated with an individual site
operations.summary: Get a comma-separated string of all pids for a given site
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] parcels pids [PARAMS] format id output site [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents sites near a given point in the order of closest to farthest
operations.summary: Find sites near to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sites near output format [PARAMS] back brief civic descriptor distance exclude format location max only output point results set srs units [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the site nearest a given point
operations.summary: Find the site nearest to a geographic point
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sites nearest output format [PARAMS] back brief civic descriptor distance exclude format location max only output point set srs units [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents sites within a given area
operations.summary: Find sites in a geographic area
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sites within output format [PARAMS] back bbox brief civic descriptor exclude format location max only output results set srs units [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get a site by its unique ID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sites [PARAMS] back brief descriptor format id location output set site srs [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents all subsites of a given site
operations.summary: Represents all subsites of a given site
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] sites subsites output format [PARAMS] back brief descriptor format id location output set site srs [SCHEMA]
